query: Which higher-frequency proxy endpoints (ATP exceedance thresholds, near-miss logs, corrective-clean triggers, ATP rolling averages) should we include and how will we validate their predictive value for true contamination events?

response.query: Which higher-frequency proxy endpoints (ATP exceedance thresholds, near-miss logs, corrective-clean triggers, ATP rolling averages) should we include and how will we validate their predictive value for true contamination events?
response.answer: Include ATP exceedance thresholds and corrective-clean triggers for monitoring. Validate predictive value through statistical analysis of historical contamination events. Use rolling averages for trend identification.
